_comment: Every metered API, in one place. To sell a new API: add an object, put its key in .env, restart.
${VAR} is read from the environment at spawn time; ${VAR:-default} falls back. A lane whose
required vars are missing is SKIPPED, because a keyless gateway would quote and then 401.
Pricing: meter = tokens | tokens:output | rows | rows:<path> | bytes | ms | json:<path> | request
rate = HBAR per `per` units; min = minimum per paid call; maxUnits = seller cap per call.
Buyers cap a call with the header x-meter-max-units (or max_tokens in an LLM body).
tab: true offers Metered Tabs (allowance-backed sessions + streaming) on that lane.
Payouts go to the top-level wallet.

lanes.name: llm
lanes.title: AI Chat
lanes._note: Groq (OpenAI-compatible). Set GROQ_API_KEY in .env. Streams token by token on a tab.
lanes.description: Open-source LLM (gpt-oss-20b on Groq). You pay for the tokens a reply actually uses, and can stream it.

lanes.name: weather
lanes.title: Weather Forecast
lanes._note: Open-Meteo: open data, no key at all. Priced per hour of forecast returned.
lanes.description: Hourly weather forecasts for any coordinates, from Open-Meteo. Priced per forecast hour returned.

lanes.name: weather-budget
lanes.title: Weather Budget
lanes._note: Open-Meteo: open data, no key at all. Priced per hour of forecast returned.
lanes.description: The same Open-Meteo forecasts at the lowest rate on the market, from a seller with no track record yet.

lanes.name: weather-premium
lanes.title: Weather Premium
lanes._note: Open-Meteo: open data, no key at all. Priced per hour of forecast returned.
lanes.description: Open-Meteo forecasts at a premium rate, or by subscription: 0.02 HBAR a period with 200 forecast hours included.

lanes.name: etherscan
lanes.title: Ethereum Transactions
lanes.description: Ethereum transaction history for any address, from Etherscan. Priced per transaction returned.

lanes.name: uniswap-data
lanes.title: Uniswap Pools
lanes.body: {"query":"{ pools(first: 5, orderBy: totalValueLockedUSD, orderDirection: desc) { id totalValueLockedUSD } }"}
lanes.description: Uniswap v3 pools and TVL from The Graph. Priced per pool returned.

lanes.name: tally
lanes.title: DAO Governance
lanes.description: DAO governance data from Tally: chains, proposals. Priced per record returned.

lanes.name: alphavantage
lanes.title: Stock Quotes
lanes.description: Stock quotes from Alpha Vantage. One flat price per quote.

lanes.name: dex-pools
lanes.title: DEX Pools Everywhere
lanes._note: The Graph: one Messari-standardized query over Uniswap v3 (7 chains), SushiSwap, PancakeSwap, Curve, Balancer, Camelot, Velodrome. serve.ts starts src/graph/server.ts when GRAPH_API_KEY is set.
lanes.description: Liquidity pools across DEXes and chains from The Graph's standardized subgraphs: TVL, 24h volume, fee and fee APR in one shape. Priced per pool returned.

lanes.name: dex-pools-base
lanes.title: DEX Pools · USDC on Base
lanes._note: The same Graph data, settled in USDC on Base Sepolia (x402 exact, EIP-3009). Skipped until WALLET_EVM is set (scripts/new-chain-wallets.ts).
lanes.description: Standardized DEX pool data from The Graph, paid in USDC on Base Sepolia. Priced per pool returned.

lanes.name: uniswap-quote
lanes.title: Uniswap Swap Quotes
lanes._note: Uniswap Trading API POST /quote (trade-api.gateway.uniswap.org). Needs UNISWAP_API_KEY. One price per routed quote.
lanes.description: Executable swap quotes from the Uniswap Trading API on 20+ chains: route, output, price impact and gas in USD. One flat price per quote.

lanes.name: weather-solana
lanes.title: Weather · USDC on Solana
lanes._note: Open-Meteo, settled in USDC on Solana devnet (x402 exact, SPL transfer, facilitator pays fees). Skipped until WALLET_SOLANA is set.
lanes.description: Hourly Open-Meteo forecasts paid in USDC on Solana devnet. Priced per forecast hour returned.

lanes.name: lending-markets
lanes.title: Lending Rates Everywhere
lanes._note: The Graph: one Messari-standardized lending query over Aave v3 (7 chains), Compound v2/v3, Spark, Venus, Benqi, Radiant. Served by src/graph/server.ts when GRAPH_API_KEY is set.
lanes.description: Supply and borrow rates across lending protocols and chains from The Graph's standardized subgraphs: APY, deposits, utilization and max LTV in one shape. Priced per market returned.

lanes.name: subgraph-gateway
lanes.title: Any Subgraph, Per Entity
lanes._note: Any subgraph on The Graph Network without a Graph API key: POST { query } to /subgraphs/<id>; billed per object in the answer (json:entities). Errors and empty answers cost nothing.
lanes.body: {"query":"{ pools(first: 5, orderBy: totalValueLockedUSD, orderDirection: desc, where: { totalValueLockedUSD_lt: \"5000000000\" }) { id feeTier totalValueLockedUSD token0 { symbol } token1 { symbol } } }"}
lanes.description: Run any GraphQL query on any of The Graph's 15,000+ subgraphs without your own API key. Priced per entity returned; a query that errors or finds nothing is free.
